Name: Gerard Way - Custom NPC
Author: Deany1511
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds Gerard Way from My Chemical Romance to the valley, along with custom events

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]You need to also have Content Patcher downloaded


I used music already in Stardew Valley's files in the mod, but if you have legally acquired .ogg files of MCR music, you can replace the music with it following this short tutorial --
Drop two songs in the music folder that is inside the assets folder of the mod, preferably an instrumental + a vocal song. I used Ghost of You instrumental and Helana vocal.
Then open the content.json in the mod folder and replace where it says MCR_GOY_Inst with the name of your instrumental (doesn't actually need to be instrumental) file and replace MCR_H with the name of your vocal (doesn't actually need to be vocal) file.
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "Data/AudioChanges",
            "Entries": {
                "{{ModId}}_GerardMusic": {
                    "ID": "{{ModId}}_GerardMusic",
                    "Category": "Music",
                    "FilePaths": [ "{{AbsoluteFilePath: assets/Music/MCR_GOY_Inst.ogg}}" ],
                    "StreamedVorbis": true,
                    "Looped": true
                }
    }
        },
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "Data/AudioChanges",
            "Entries": {
                "{{ModId}}_MCRBandMusic": {
                    "ID": "{{ModId}}_MCRBandMusic",
                    "Category": "Music",
                    "FilePaths": [ "{{AbsoluteFilePath: assets/Music/MCR_H.ogg}}" ],
                    "StreamedVorbis": true,
                    "Looped": true
                }
    }
        },
Then replace where the music is referenced in the content.json, which is in several locations but only two different kinds. Replace "cowboy_boss" with {{ModId}}_MCRBandMusic and replace "heavy" with {{ModId}}_GerardMusic.

If you like this mod, or have feedback/questions, tell me about it!
